List watch groups with their acknowledged event, lag and last use

## Usage

```text
chainmail watch groups
```

## Examples

```sh
chainmail watch groups
```

## Global flags

```text
      --output string   output format: json or table (default $CHAINMAIL_OUTPUT, then cli.toml, then table on a terminal, json otherwise)
      --socket string   daemon socket (default $CHAINMAIL_SOCKET, then cli.toml, then /run/chainmail/chainmail.sock)
```

## Commands

- [chainmail watch groups delete](./chainmail-watch-groups-delete.md): Delete a watch group, so its next use starts at the newest event
